name: Examination
definition: 在特定时间点对某位就诊者实施的一组实验室检测与临床观察结果的汇总记录，包含自身抗体、凝血功能及临床表现等观测项。 Counterexample: 与单次单项检验结果（如仅一条 Laboratory 记录）不同，检查记录是一次就诊中多项检测与症状信息的集合性信息记录。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Examination; provenance: direct source Examination

name: Laboratory
definition: 在某一日期对某位就诊者采集样本后，由检验科室完成的一组生化、血液与凝血指标的定量或定性测定结果记录。 Counterexample: 与检查记录（Examination）不同，实验室检验记录聚焦于检验科仪器产出的数值型指标，不含症状描述与诊断结论。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Laboratory; provenance: direct source Laboratory

name: Patient
definition: 接受医疗服务的自然人，具有性别、出生日期等固有属性，并作为检查与检验记录的归属主体。 Counterexample: 与医生、护士等医疗提供者不同，患者是服务的接受方而非提供方；与检查记录不同，患者是持续存在的实体而非一次性的信息记录。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table Patient; provenance: direct source Patient

name: Anticardiolipin_IgM
definition: Anticardiolipin antibody IgM measurement for a patient on an examination date.

name: Uric_Acid
definition: Serum uric acid level from laboratory tests.

name: Hematocrit
definition: Hematocrit percentage from laboratory tests.

name: Thrombosis_Severity
definition: Severity code of thrombosis recorded in examination.

name: Diagnosis
definition: Clinical diagnosis assigned to a patient.

name: Anti_SM
definition: Anti-Smith antibody result from laboratory tests.

name: Total_Cholesterol
definition: Total cholesterol level from laboratory tests.

name: Symptoms
definition: Symptoms recorded during examination.
scope: Examination where Symptoms IS NOT NULL

name: Red_Blood_Cell
definition: Red blood cell count from laboratory tests.

name: Sex
definition: Patient sex.

name: Birthday
definition: Patient date of birth.

name: IgA
definition: Immunoglobulin A level from laboratory tests.

name: First_Date
definition: Date of first hospital visit.

name: LDH
definition: Lactate dehydrogenase level from laboratory tests.

name: Admission
definition: Admission status of the patient.
aliases: immediately followed at the outpatient clinic

name: Prothrombin_Time
definition: Prothrombin time from laboratory tests.

name: Examination_Date
definition: Date when examination was performed.

name: Description
definition: Description or date field in patient record.

name: Age
definition: Patient age calculated from birthday to current year. Formula: YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(Birthday). Inputs: Birthday = Patient.Birthday

name: Abnormal_Uric_Acid
definition: Flag for uric acid outside normal range based on sex. Formula: CASE WHEN (Sex = 'M' AND Uric_Acid > 8.0) OR (Sex = 'F' AND Uric_Acid > 6.5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: Uric_Acid = Laboratory.UA; Sex = Patient.SEX

name: Abnormal_Hematocrit
definition: Flag for hematocrit outside normal range. Formula: CASE WHEN Hematocrit > 52 OR Hematocrit < 37 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: Hematocrit = Laboratory.HCT

name: Abnormal_PT
definition: Flag for prothrombin time above normal threshold. Formula: CASE WHEN Prothrombin_Time >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: Prothrombin_Time = Laboratory.PT

name: Normal_Anti_SM
definition: Flag for anti-SM result within normal range. Formula: CASE WHEN Anti_SM IN ('-', '+-') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: Anti_SM = Laboratory.SM

name: Normal_IgA
definition: Flag for IgA within normal range. Formula: CASE WHEN IgA > 80 AND IgA < 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: IgA = Laboratory.IGA

name: Cholesterol_Decrease_Rate
definition: Rate of decrease in total cholesterol between two months. Formula: (Total_Cholesterol_Nov - Total_Cholesterol_Dec) / Total_Cholesterol_Nov. Inputs: Total_Cholesterol = Laboratory.T-CHO

name: Female_Percentage
definition: Percentage of female patients in a group. Formula: SUM(CASE WHEN Sex = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100. Inputs: Sex = Patient.SEX

name: Male_Female_Ratio
definition: Ratio of male to female patients. Formula: SUM(CASE WHEN Sex = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN Sex = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END). Inputs: Sex = Patient.SEX

name: Abnormal_LDH
definition: Flag for LDH above normal threshold. Formula: CASE WHEN LDH > 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: LDH = Laboratory.LDH

name: Abnormal_RBC
definition: Flag for red blood cell count below normal threshold. Formula: CASE WHEN Red_Blood_Cell < 3.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. Inputs: Red_Blood_Cell = Laboratory.RBC

name: Thrombosis_Severity
definition: Analysis of thrombosis severity levels and associated patient outcomes.

name: Diagnosis_Type
definition: Analysis of patient diagnoses and their distributions.

name: Anti_SM_Status
definition: Analysis of anti-SM antibody results and normality.
